snippet.title: Mimania - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
MIMANIA on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3167930/Mimania/

MIMANIA is a survival horror game where your goal is to find all the mimics hidden in different locations. These mimics are disguised as ordinary objects, so keep your eyes open for any strange behaviour.
